reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Custom Pools by Brian exceeded every expectation we had. From start to finish, Brian has been nothing short of fantastic to work with. He only uses trusted subcontractors he’s built strong relationships with, and he always advocates for the homeowner if anything needs to be addressed. The entire process was incredibly smooth — something most homeowners can’t say about building a pool!

The quality of the pool itself is second to none. Brian goes above and beyond, reinforcing the rebar far beyond code to ensure a pool that’s truly built to last a lifetime. We couldn’t be happier with the finished product and our overall experience.

We also have several friends who’ve worked with Brian and they’ve had the exact same positive experience. We’ve already referred him to numerous people and will continue to do so. If I had to do it all over again, I wouldn’t change a thing.

If you’re looking for a pool builder you can trust, who delivers quality and peace of mind, Brian is the one.
reviews.author: Jason Tejeda

reviews.text:
Everyone we asked before we embark on building our pool were telling us not to do it as contractors are expensive, not reliable, and at the end you end up with not what you were looking for, over budget and sometime a year later in delivery to your original plan.

We built a pool 10 years ago in Austin and we had great experience, we were looking in Plano TX for similar contractor and we came across Pools by Brian with amazing reviews that looked too good to be true. But after 2.5 month start to finish of this project we can testify that the reviews and reality are true and Brian is a class of his own- WOW !!!!

highly recommended - great service, accountability, end to end delivery and no surprises on budget or schedule
reviews.author: Ari Rauch

reviews.text: Brian and Teddy did such a great job of helping design and complete our pool, we didn't know what we wanted and Teddy walked us through the design process and Brian is a hands on owner, he walked us through the permit process, which with his help went very fast and even through HSA he knew what we would need and provided ahead of time. When construction started Brian was here almost everyday that a sub was here and made sure everything was flowing well and we understand the process. It was a very good experience. and the timeline that he gave us was spot on, even with the weather delays and things he couldn't control we were completed right on time. If you are thinking about a pool or spa, we highly recommend Custom Pools by Brian, they truly are the best.
reviews.author: Kevin Reynolds

reviews.text:
I cannot say enough about Teddy and Brian. This company truly took great care of us. They explained everything, were always there’s for texts and calls, really treated us like people not piggy banks. They were totally hands on for the entire project. I felt totally comfortable having them all around my house where my wife and kids were, they are total professionals and really great people.

The pool turned out totally amazing, we actually got to swim in it this weekend. It went by so fast we almost couldn’t believe it. We vacation to tropical resorts every year and our pool now looks like a resort. It’s not some run of the mill pool you’ve seen before. These fellas can go as extravagant or as simple as you want.

Thank you Pools by Brian for taking care of me and my family so very well! We totally recommend this company without a doubt.
reviews.author: A Wood

reviews.text: Brian and Teddy  did an amazing job. Customer service and communication that is certainly uncommon in today's business climate. The quality and attention to detail was impeccable. Every crew was professional and some of the best I have seen. Highly recommend Brian and his team.  Thanks for a great experience and a beautiful pool.
reviews.author: Max Klein

reviews.text: Brian and Teddy run a tight ship. Start to finish the process was stress free. We love our new outdoor living space.
reviews.author: Rick Morton

reviews.text: We are extremely happy with Custom Pools by Brian. Brian is amazing at getting things done  right and communicating every step of the way. Brian will personally make sure that everything is working well too. He has answered our 1,000,000 questions quickly and with clarity.  He is a  genuinely friendly person, and we enjoyed working with him. He has integrity and will follow through. 10 out of 10 would recommend!!
reviews.author: Delaine Schonhoff

reviews.text:
Custom Pools by Brian is one of the most underrated pool companies in the DFW metroplex area. We just completed our pool, in 8 weeks! and couldn't be happier!
Breaking down pro's and cons of the end-to-end process:
PROS:
-Very small company with a down-to-earth authentic team- Teddy (Sales) Brian (Owner and Pretty much everything else)
- Budget awareness - we were very clear on our budget from the get-go and Teddy and Brian went above and beyond our expectations on value.
- Excellent Referrals for projects that fall out of scope e.g. landscaping, irrigation etc.
- Project moves VERY quickly - completed pool in 8 weeks which included 1.5 weeks of rain delay. Brian does an amazing job of not overbooking projects so delivers on time!
- Brian (owner) is onsite pretty much EVERY DAY and has eyes on your project at all times.
- Constant Communication and updates - Brian will text you constantly with what to expect and next steps, even though he gives you a project schedule sheet.
- Issues are taken care of right away. Again, Brian ensures all contractors are on-top-of their game and one time.

CONS:
- No showroom which means you will have pick out materials yourself in showrooms. Not a big deal given their pricing.
- If you're bidding out your project, they don't give you fancy project booklets etc. to wow but look past this because the attention you get thereafter from them is second to none.
- You will need to submit paperwork to your HOA (provided by Brian and team), we were ok with this.

Overall, this has been one of the best construction experiences we've had. We are extremely happy with how our pool turned out and even happier with the company we picked!
reviews.author: Sheena Bhan
